ClientEscalationContactCreateRequest.title: ClientEscalationContactCreateRequest
ClientEscalationContactCreateRequest.description: Who Tavi escalates to when the site contact can't decide, such as a facility manager.

site_contact.description: The on-site contact Tavi coordinates the visit with. Matched by phone to an existing contact in your organization, or created, and added to the site's team. Use instead of client_owner_user_id.

escalation_contact.description: Who Tavi escalates to when the site contact can't decide, such as a facility manager. Matched by phone to an existing contact in your organization, or created, and added to the site's team.

context.title: Context
context.description: Anything else Tavi should know: access instructions, opening hours, or customer specifics. Shown to Tavi alongside the description.

ClientJobDetailResponse.title: ClientJobDetailResponse
ClientJobDetailResponse.description: A work order with its sourcing progress, quotes, visits and sign-off evidence. Subcontractor identities are never included; Tavi is the contracted provider.

ClientJobResponse.title: ClientJobResponse
ClientJobResponse.description: A work order as it appears in a list.

ClientJobVisitReadResponse.title: ClientJobVisitReadResponse
ClientJobVisitReadResponse.description: A site visit or work visit, with arrival and departure times, who signed off, and sign-off photos.

ClientLocationCreate.title: ClientLocationCreate
ClientLocationCreate.description: A new site. Tavi geocodes the address.

ClientOptionApproveRequest.title: ClientOptionApproveRequest
ClientOptionApproveRequest.description: The option's terms as you read them: pre_tax_amount, tax_amount and scope_of_work from the option. Tavi refuses the approval if any of them changed since.

ClientOptionApproveResponse.title: ClientOptionApproveResponse

download_url.description: Link to the file's content. Works without an API key and stays valid for at least 30 days; read the work order again for a fresh link.

FileResponse.title: FileResponse
FileResponse.description: A stored photo or file. download_url works without an API key for at least 30 days.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description: DRAFT: received, Tavi is reviewing it. ACTIVE: Tavi is sourcing, scheduling or doing the work. SETTLEMENT: work done, payment processing. COMPLETED: closed. CANCELLED: cancelled.
